name: Filesystem Security
purpose: Enforce path traversal prevention, symlink resolution checks, file permission masks, and safe temporary file handling.
inputs: Authorized roots, path types, untrusted inputs, and operation matrix
Platform, symlink and hardlink behavior, permissions, mounts, and temporary-directory policy
File-size and count limits, atomicity, recovery, and abuse-test requirements
outputs: Safe path, descriptor, permission, temporary-file, and atomic-write implementation
Traversal, symlink, TOCTOU, permission, and resource-bound test evidence
stop_conditions: No attacker-controlled path can read, write, execute, or escape an authorized root
All mutations are bounded, permission-safe, atomic where required, and audited
Token budget exhausted or platform filesystem behavior cannot be verified
